fix_code:
def find_nth_good_integer(N: int) -> str:
    N -= 1
    rems = []
    if N == 0:
        return "0"
    while N > 0:
        quotient = N // 5
        remainder = N % 5
        rems.append(remainder)
        N = quotient
    converted = rems[::-1]
    converted = ''.join([str(c * 2) for c in converted])
    return converted
